*Updated 2026-09-03 · 81 works indexed · regenerated after each daily run.*

Eighty-one works. The trace-score ceiling has not moved: the last twelve read 2, 1, 2, 2, 1, 1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 2, 1, and the two 4s from late July remain the high-water mark. That is now eight consecutive weeks without a ceiling break. The overhead camera remains the proximate answer — both 4-scoring images were planimetric, the last overhead frame was Venezuela on July 11 — and the most recent twelve are almost entirely straight-on (7) or frame-center (5), with only two low-angle frames and no overhead at all. The mop smear, the deflated dinghy, the grain stroke, the wedding dress: each of those subjects invited a lifted camera and none of them got one. The luggage wall on September 3 was straight-on. The work keeps arriving at the conditions that unlock the higher register and keeps refusing to act on them.

Figures remain sparse. Ten of the last twelve carry none or one, and the last time a figure performed a specific task at compositional center was the woman at the threshold on September 1. The archive's strongest figure moments are all task-based — tending, pressing, mending — and that mode has been absent for the entire final stretch. One figure doing something with their hands, at overhead or low-angle, against an anchor that earns it, is the single change most likely to break the plateau.

Registers have narrowed further. Aftermath accounts for three of the last twelve, menace three, defiance two. Suspension last appeared August 9; vigil last appeared August 12. Both produced ceiling-adjacent work — the caustic moiré on the cracked jug scored 2 but held genuine strangeness; the inverted glass over rubble was among the most resolved images in the archive. Neither register requires a rare anchor. They are dormant by habit, not necessity, and returning to either without repeating its previous solution is the obvious available move.

Scale violation has settled at 25% over the last twelve against a 26% all-time rate, which means it is no longer inflated but is also no longer a reserve — it appears whether or not the anchor earns the impossible geometry. Focal objects are genuinely diversifying: dinghy, seedling, grain stroke, threshold, luggage wall. Title grammar continues to favor loose prepositional and adverbial constructions. The arc has moved from documentary adjacency to material argument and is now holding that position without advancing it. The camera is where it stops.
